asA: verifier at the TEST stage, with the reviewer reading the result
iWant: a tool that fails any bound test reaching around the app entry, mocking an internal module, or relying on a silently defaulted logger, emitter or sender
soThat: a green suite means production as wired does what the criteria say
title: The verifier runs the structural check over the bound tests of the touched criteria

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture project whose rcf/test-strength.json declares entry [{"kind": "bin", "path": "bin/app.js"}] and harness ["test/_harness/**"], and whose AC-101-1 is bound to test/rcf/a.test.js importing only node:test, node:assert and test/_harness/run.js (which spawns bin/app.js), with a symbol-level Code Node whose mutants all fail that test, when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then it exits 0 and stdout is "test-strength: PASS 1 criteria at <h7>: structural 1/1, mutants killed 3/3 (timeout 0, notApplicable 0)" (or killed 2/2 with notApplicable 1 when call removal finds no call site).

[failure] Given the same fixture with test/rcf/a.test.js also importing src/store.js (a product file that is not the entry), when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then it exits 4 and stdout is "test-strength: FAIL 1 of 1 criteria at <h7>: AC-101-1 imports src/store.js (not the app entry or the harness)".

[failure] Given the same fixture with test/rcf/a.test.js calling mock.module("../../src/mailer.js", ...) and rcf/test-strength.json declaring edge ["node:https"], the verb exits 4 with "AC-101-1 mocks ../../src/mailer.js (not a declared edge)"; a mock.module("node:https", ...) in the same test is not a finding.

[failure] Given a Code Node src/notify.js#makeNotifier implementing AC-101-1 whose function is makeNotifier({ sender = consoleSender } = {}), when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then it exits 4 with "AC-101-1 silent default sender in src/notify.js#makeNotifier"; a parameter named sender with no default is not a finding.

[edge] Given a fixture project with no rcf/test-strength.json, rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 exits 2 with stderr "test-strength: no rcf/test-strength.json; declare entry and harness"; given no --acs, no --fbs and no REVIEW verdict reachable from HEAD, it exits 2 with "test-strength: no scope; pass --acs or --fbs, or record a REVIEW verdict"; given --acs AC-999-1 it exits 2 naming AC-999-1.

[must-not] The structural check never executes a test, the entry or any product module: it reads bound test files and Code Node sources as text, so a bound test file that would throw on import still yields its import findings, and a structural-only failure is reported without running a single mutant.

[edge] Given --acs AC-101-1,AC-101-2 where AC-101-1's bound test imports src/store.js and AC-101-2 passes the structural check, rcf audit test-strength runs the structural check for both first, runs mutants for AC-101-2 only, exits 4 naming AC-101-1's imports finding, and --json lists mutants for AC-101-2 and none for AC-101-1.

[failure] Given a bound test file test/rcf/a.test.ts, or a Code Node on src/x.ts, rcf audit test-strength exits 2 with stderr "test-strength: <path> is not a supported source (JavaScript ESM or CommonJS)" and runs no mutant; bound tests and Code Nodes in .js, .mjs and .cjs files are read.
